faces.transcription:
PART 1
THIS IS THE LEGACY DECK
Read the rules (Read page 3 aloud to all players), then draw this card during Step 1 of Setup for your Prologue game.

MISSION BRIEFING
"Agents: it's time to head out. It's okay to be a little nervous; every new agent is. This one's pretty straightforward though: we have intel on a sample of the MEDUSA plague somewhere in Europe and a sighting of Agent Sabik in Novosibirsk. Couple of reminders here before you go:

First, try to keep a handle on Soviet agents, but remember that your teams will do a lot of that heavy lifting once you set 'em up. Second, don't forget that flying to Allied countries is easy; we've paid off all the right people. If you need to go somewhere friendly to the Reds, you can do it, but flying won't be easy."
